title: Duran Duran
scene: British New Romantic / Birmingham new wave
influenced_by: Chic|Sex Pistols|Roxy Music|The Human League (Reproduction)|Giorgio Moroder
notes: Angular dance-punk pulse meets sequenced synths, club bass and theatrical post-punk unease.

title: Rio
notes: Elastic live rhythm section, bright synthesizers, saxophone and shadowy ballads beneath glossy pop.

title: Seven and the Ragged Tiger
notes: Densely constructed synth-funk and stadium pop alternate with jazzy saxophone and melancholy atmosphere.

title: Notorious
notes: Nile Rodgers redirects the band toward clipped funk guitar, real horns and falsetto.
